fields.description: Bayz 101 is an apartment tower in Business Bay. Its plan collection ranges from studios to four-bedroom homes, with selected private-pool layouts and shared leisure spaces at several elevated levels.

sources.label: Official public factsheet ZIP · Bayz101_A4_factsheet_EN.pdf, 6 pages
Official public floorplan ZIP · Bayz101_floor_plans_ver2.pdf, 26 pages
Developer promotion labelled Bayz101 with conflicting timeline/asset labels

reviewCoverage.identity: Bayz 101 identity checked against its own project page and named plan documents; related phases are separated.
reviewCoverage.location: The sources identify Business Bay, Dubai. No coordinates or guaranteed travel times were invented.
reviewCoverage.residences: The published Studio–4 range was checked against the named layout families; convertible spaces are not counted as extra bedrooms.
reviewCoverage.areas: Numeric plan panels were rendered and visually inspected. Apartment, balcony and total figures are kept distinct; source conflicts are disclosed below.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Project facilities were checked against the cited own page or phase-specific guide. Unit pools are limited to the layouts that show them.
reviewCoverage.pricing: The price basis and source are disclosed. Historical launch references, averages and current availability are not treated as interchangeable.
reviewCoverage.payment: Published schedules were compared and arithmetic reviewed. Conflicting or incomplete current terms remain unresolved rather than merged.
reviewCoverage.handover: Forecast dates are separated from dated construction assessments; no actual handover is inferred from a percentage or elapsed forecast.
reviewCoverage.documents: Named brochures, plans and available commercial documents were reviewed. Numeric evidence, phase distinctions and document allocations are recorded in the project artifact.

overview: Some drawings use marketing labels such as executive or presidential. The selected plan and approved bedroom count matter more than the label; a convertible studio should not automatically be treated as a one-bedroom home.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai, near Sheikh Zayed Road and the district’s Metro connection. Actual access, views and route timings depend on the selected home.
research.priceNote: The developer’s portfolio advertises AED 1.175 million, also stated in Property Finder’s project guide. This is a marketing reference, not a dated quotation for an available home, selected view or payment promotion.
research.paymentNote: The own portfolio says 30/70; Property Finder lists 10/63/1/26. A separate developer promotion advertises 0% down and 2% monthly, yet displays a 10%+10% opening calendar with 30% due in January 2030. Its mixed Bayz102 asset labels prevent safe attribution of one contractual schedule to this record.
research.handoverNote: The main developer portfolio and Property Finder forecast June 2028. A separate developer promotion labelled Bayz101 describes late 2029/January 2030 while also using Bayz102 asset labels. The selected release’s contractual date therefore remains unresolved. The developer’s 30 September 2026 inspection reports 25% progress, not completion.

facts.label: Developer scope
facts.value: 1,346 apartments advertised; not a current available-unit count.

unresolved: The portfolio and promotional timeline/payment references cannot be safely merged. A current dated developer offer identifying the exact project, release and unit is required.
Approved service charges, parking allocation, furnishing inventory, pool obligations, precise area statement, construction certification and live stock remain unverified. Images remain illustrative.
